decision.explanation: Both the Academy of Sciences of Turin (supported by D1S4 and related segments) and the Real Academia Nacional de Medicina de España (supported by D2S4 and related segments) are explicitly stated as organizations Gabriel Dépéret was a member of. These are distinct entities and both are directly named in the provided sources. There is no clear contradiction between the two claims, and they refer to separate affiliations in different domains—science and medicine.
